about: SCION 23 dog clip library. Absolute local values per key (cm, deg); drawOrder lists slots back to front; ik mix per leg constraint; events fire on the time line.

idle.note: standing, facing the door, alert; breathing and a slow tail sway

cringe-back.note: the call lands: haunches drop, head and ears go down, tail tucks (root motion backwards comes from the score, the feet from the foot planner)

turn-away.note: turns its back: body view 0 -> 45 -> 90 -> 135 deg by attachment swaps and slot reorders, head 0.12 s ahead, feet stepping round (planner)

lie.note: lies down with its back to the door, then rests its chin on its paws

look-back.note: HEAD TRACK: lifts the head off the paws and turns it back over the shoulder to the door, muzzle level, while the body track still lies

rise.note: gets up still looking at the door, then the body comes round 135 -> 0 deg under the head (attachments swap back, far legs go behind again)

stalk-walk.note: comes, head low below the line of the back; the legs are not keyed: the foot planner plants each paw (IK) as the root travels with the score

lie-across.note: lies down across the sill: forelegs and head inside, haunches and tail outside

look-in.note: HEAD TRACK: turns the head into the room, away from the camera: the back of the skull and both ears to the viewer, the muzzle level inside the lit doorway

settle.note: stays: the chin goes down onto the paws, across the sill
